title: Cho et al., AlScN ferroelectric endurance in sub-50 nm devices (arXiv 2504.13285)
supports: Write endurance above 1e10 cycles in sub-50 nm Al0.64Sc0.36N, ~1,000x over earlier wurtzite benchmarks that failed before ~1e7; breakdown fields approaching 10 MV/cm (via search snippet; preprint)

title: Boron Co-Alloying in AlScN Wurtzite Ferroelectrics: Insights from an 850-Sample Combinatorial Study
supports: AlScBN films show consistently higher endurance than AlScN at equal Sc; B content saturates the coercive field near 15 cat.% B (via search snippet; preprint)

title: Ferroelectric AlBN Films by Molecular Beam Epitaxy
supports: MBE AlBN Pr ~15 uC/cm2 and Ec ~1.45 MV/cm, attributed to incomplete wake-up limited by leakage (via search snippet)

title: NTU spotlight: 12-nm ZrO2 confined in nonpolar tetragonal phase keeps antiferroelectric behaviour
supports: Interface-engineered 12 nm ZrO2 retained antiferroelectric behaviour for ~1e8 cycles (reported in Materials Today); conventional AFE ZrO2 limited by wake-up (via search snippet)

title: Supplementary information, J. Mater. Chem. C 2024 study of field cycling in ZrO2 films
supports: Field-induced ferroelectricity in tetragonal-phase ZrO2 is reversible with cycling; cycling runs up to ~5e9 cycles in the supplement (via search snippet)

title: Nanoscale 2023 (Issue 3): Hf-doped zirconia field cycling
supports: Hf-doped zirconia ferroelectric films free of serious degradation for 2.3e9-6.8e9 field cycles (via search snippet)

title: Novel Electrical Characterization Method for Antiferroelectrics using a Positive Up Negative Down Approach
supports: Thicker AFE films showed a noticeable decrease in Pr after 1e3 cycles (onset of fatigue) (via search snippet)

title: Investigation of degradation of resonant tunneling diodes based on nanoscale AlAs/GaAs heterostructures
publisher: Bauman Moscow State Technical University (Engineering Journal)
supports: RTD aging studied via Al and Si diffusion activation parameters and ohmic-contact drift; no barrier-lifetime vs current-density (charge-fluence) data found — negative result for the crystalline-barrier premise (via search snippet)

title: Imaging element, stacked-type imaging element, and solid-state imaging apparatus to improve charge transfer (US 11,744,091)
supports: Only IGZO hit in a search for oxide-semiconductor CCD charge-transfer efficiency: IGZO TFTs in an imaging stack with dark-current/QE data, no CTE data; no published IGZO CCD CTE found (negative result, via search snippet)

title: Schobitz et al., Fast domain walls governed by Oersted fields in cylindrical magnetic nanowires
supports: Spin-transfer-torque-driven domain walls in cylindrical nanowires exceed 600 m/s; current's Oersted field stabilizes Bloch-point walls (via search snippet)

title: Fernandez-Roldan and Chubykalo-Fesenko, APL Materials (Nov 2022)
supports: Micromagnetics: Bloch-point walls with Oersted-matched chirality propagate without instability at ~300 m/s; wall widens at larger current density, limiting velocity (via search snippet)

title: Bran et al., Nanoscale 2023 (Issue 18): domain walls in notched cylindrical Ni nanowires
supports: Domain-wall velocity ~1 km/s in regions without pinning centres of notched cylindrical Ni wires (via search snippet)

title: Current-induced motion of magnetic domain walls in cylindrical nanowires with chemical modulations (thesis)
supports: >1 km/s wall motion between modulation sites driven by STT, Oersted field and Joule heating that cannot be disentangled; earlier experiments reached several hundred m/s but with stochastic pinning (via search snippet)
